aid.value: The specific first-year international page lists academic merit of at least $23,000, while the international scholarship page advertises awards starting at $25,000: https://www.hollins.edu/admission-aid/financial-aid/undergraduate-financial-aid-scholarships/scholarships-and-cost-of-attendance-for-international-students/ . Confirm the applicable award and renewal; do not invent a guaranteed net cost. Its cost table is 2025–26, not the current intake. Additional friendship support and campus jobs are limited, not universal full-need coverage. Domestic FAFSA/net-price-calculator assumptions and named domestic restricted awards are not applied to international students.

testing.value: The international-specific checklist requires SAT or ACT, but permits a requested waiver using alternative Cambridge, IB or AP standardized results. Do not assume general first-year/Common App test-optional advertising is an unconditional international waiver. English-proficiency waivers are a different requirement.

evidence.quote: students may apply for a waiver

english.value: Non-native speakers: old TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS 6.5 or DET 110. Waiver alternatives: three years of all-English secondary instruction, SAT EBRW 610 or ACT English 26. Supply the latest English instructor's recommendation describing coursework/proficiency. Older computer/paper TOEFL references do not establish currently available tests or a new-scale minimum; confirm newer exams. Admission proficiency does not necessarily satisfy the degree's language requirement.

fee.value: The international admission application is free. Document translations, tests, visa and enrollment costs remain separate. The women's undergraduate program has its own eligibility; adult Horizon, transfer and graduate admission are separate routes.

evidence.quote: There is no cost to submit your application

deadline.value: The current first-year table lists binding ED October 15, non-binding EA November 1 and RD February 1. No intake year is labelled; confirm applicability and international spring eligibility before applying. Preferred FAFSA dates in the adjacent column are not international admission dates; scholarship competitions have separate requirements. Do not substitute Horizon/adult or historical event dates.
